the_logic.consequence: settings[0x9C] can only become 0, and SD aggregation can only be disabled, when Media Write Mode is 2 or higher.

this_explains_the_failed_live_attempt: On 2026-09-24 the camera read 1, was set to 0 with menu SetMediaWriteMode 0, and the settings slot was written to 0 by hand. After one recording the slot read 1 again. That is exactly what this table predicts: v3 re-ran at recording start and, seeing a value of 0, wrote 1. Setting the menu to 0 was the wrong direction - 0 and 1 give the same result.
